product_metadata.title: Amici Home, , Rustic Kitchen Galvanized Metal Bread Storage Bin, 288 oz, Gray
features: Metal Bread Bin - This large bread box is perfect for any kitchen countertop. It's great for storing and organizing all sorts of baked goods without cluttering your kitchen. This bread keeper also makes a great addition to your kitchen and will complement your other kitchen sets!

Rustic Design - This metal storage box features a rustic galvanized finish for that vintage farmhouse look. Our rustic bread box complements any home décor and will look great on your kitchen countertop.

Premium Construction - Made from high quality metal, these bread boxes for kitchen counter are super durable and built to last for a long time. Unlike plastic, our farmhouse bread box does not discolor or absorb smell. It's also BPA-free. Hand washing is recommended to maintain finish and function.

Keeps Food Fresh - Measuring 13.5” x 7.5” x 9.5”, our metal canister features a matching metal lid with silicone gasket to lock in freshness and keep out unwanted guests. It keeps your bread, muffins, cookies, cakes, loaves, and other pastries super fresh!
Product Specifications - Package contains (1) Amici Home Rustic Kitchen Metal Bread Bin. Material: Metal. Measurements: 288 Oz. Product Care: Handwash with care.
